sources.title: pinkelephantlimited/pinkelephant-llm-48b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pink Elephant 48B was upcycled, not trained from scratch. The feedforward weights of the established pink-elephant-llm-14b dense foundation were mathematically split and replicated into eight complementary experts — preserving the parent model's knowledge while multiplying capacity roughly threefold. Scaling through intelligence, not brute force.
